low.title: Cited T2 deletion revision does not contain the deleted page in its tree
low.description: The historical-source-denominator evidence row cites revision c76f6af3f62c03979f5073a871e775afd952a070 for both abyssal-well/page.tsx and babel-architect/page.tsx, but git ls-tree at that revision shows neither path. The file content is at the parent revision 8611070b9debece772f0e686a08f4cfcfc495880, not at c76f6af3. The cited blob SHA-256 nevertheless matches the parent-revision content because git show <rev>:<path> walks back when the path is absent at <rev>. This is consistent with the historical-source-denominator's claim that these are the first-commit deletions and is not a defect, but the citation would be less ambiguous if it pointed to the parent (last-present) revision.
low.severity_rationale: Does not break any validator check; the SHA-256 of the cited file content is correct. Recorded only so a future maintainer is not surprised.
